date_note: Date of the first status post; the incident recurred on 18 November and Akamai marked it resolved on 21 November.
title: Akamai Edge Delivery degraded in Singapore and Japan, recurred next day, marked resolved 21 November
geo_basis: country: the status page names the Singapore and Japan regions
summary: Akamai's status page reports an emerging Cloud Wrapper issue affecting Edge Delivery in Singapore, with latency, video playback failures and packet drops. Akamai said Edge Delivery in Singapore and Japan resumed healthy service on 17 November, identified a reoccurrence on 18 November, and on 21 November said it considered the issue mitigated. The page does not give a cause.
plain: Akamai's status page says its content delivery service was slow or failing in Singapore and Japan on two days that week.Akamai says it considers the issue mitigated.
exec: Akamai's own status page records a recurring regional delivery degradation, later marked mitigated.

validation.note: Akamai's own status page only. Its recovery times for 18 November differ between updates.

review.note: Compared dates, regions, recurrence, mitigated status and no-cause statement with Akamai status page
